Interface MainView

All Superinterfaces:
BaseView
All Known Implementing Classes:
SwingStoreView
public interface MainView extends BaseView
View interface for main application entry point and navigation. Extends BaseView to provide main application-level user interactions including welcome messages and main menu navigation.

    • displayWelcomeMessage

      void displayWelcomeMessage()
      Displays the application welcome message to the user. Typically shown at application startup to greet the user and provide initial application information.

    • displayMainMenu

      void displayMainMenu()
      Displays the main application menu to the user. Provides navigation options to different sections of the application such as product management, customer management, cart operations, etc.
